Grain
Versatile Grain Handling Services Provide Options For You
Each year you invest a significant amount of time, effort and resources into your crops, so helping you achieve the best return possible is very important to us. Whether you are storing your grain for use in animal feed or want help marketing your grain, we can help.
As a federally licensed grain dealer our knowledgeable specialists can provide expert advice about current market conditions and help develop a plan that fits your needs.
For your convenience we have multiple scales and multiple unloading pits to make unloading quicker and to help get you back to the farm for the next load. At certain times of the year our Southside location may also be accepting grain.
2026 Grain Updates and Information
Credit Term Update:
We have revised the language within our Terms and Conditions. Please note the following updates related to grain transactions:
Any account balance that remains unpaid for more than 60 days will be deducted from any payment owed by Northside Elevator, Inc. for the purchase of any commodity.
If an account balance becomes 90 days past due and grain is being stored at Northside Elevator, Inc., we reserve the right to sell the stored grain at the current market price to satisfy the outstanding balance.
ACH Grain Payment:
Northside Elevator offers ACH payment options for all grain sales. We encouraged our customers to enroll in this service for direct deposit instead of receiving a physical check by mail. Processing of all grain payments require a minimum period of 48 hours after the sale transaction.
Grain Receiving Hours Text Updates:
Stay informed of grain receiving hours throughout the harvest season by enrolling in our text or email notification service with Bushel. Enroll here: https://portal.bushelpowered.com/northside
Questions?
If you have any questions regarding these updates or our services, please contact us:
Phone: 715-255-8507
Email: customer-care@northsideelevator.com
Thank you for your continued business and cooperation. We appreciate the opportunity to serve you and wish you a safe, productive, and successful harvest season.
